map.热输入 E = (U × I × η × 60) / v (单位：J/cm): Heat input E = (U × I × η × 60) / v  (unit: J/cm)
map.U 为电弧电压(V)，I 为焊接电流(A)，v 为焊接速度(cm/min)，η: U is arc voltage (V), I is welding current (A), v is welding speed (cm/min), η is process thermal efficiency.
map.薄板低热输入 0.5~1.5 kJ/mm；一般结构钢 1.5~3.0 kJ/mm: Thin plate low heat input 0.5-1.5 kJ/mm; general structural steel 1.5-3.0 kJ/mm; thick plate / submerged arc 3.0-6.0 kJ/mm.
map.热输入过大易导致晶粒粗大、韧性下降；过小易产生冷裂纹、未熔合。: Excessive heat input coarsens grains and lowers toughness; too little tends to cause cold cracks and lack of fusion.
map.由电压、电流、效率、速度求热输入 E。: Find heat input E from voltage, current, efficiency and speed.
map.按材质控制热输入防淬硬/变形。: Control heat input by material to prevent hardening / distortion.
map.对比不同焊接方法热影响区。: Compare the heat-affected zone of different welding methods.
map.U=24V、I=180A、η=0.5、v=30cm/min：E = (24×18: U=24V, I=180A, η=0.5, v=30cm/min: E = (24×180×0.5×60)/30 = 4320 J/cm = 43.2 kJ/m (i.e. 0.432 kJ/mm), a medium-low heat input.
map.若提速到 45cm/min：E = (24×180×0.5×60)/45 = 2: If speed rises to 45cm/min: E = (24×180×0.5×60)/45 = 2880 J/cm, heat input drops by 1/3, helping high-strength steel avoid cold cracking but must keep penetration.
map.不一定；过大热影响区宽、变形大、易过热，过小则可能未熔合；高强钢、不锈钢需控在中: Not necessarily; too much widens the heat-affected zone, increases distortion and overheating, too little may lack fusion; high-strength steel and stainless steel should be controlled at the lower-middle range.
